text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0001:
[Part 1: Phantom Blood]
The only son of a distinguished English noble family.
He learned "Hamon" from Baron Zeppeli and blossomed with rare talent.
Striving to become a true "gentleman" and to uphold his own sense of justice,
he faces his strange destiny with his archenemy Dio.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0002:
[Part 1: Phantom Blood]
He was won over by Jonathan, a noble "in spirit" as well as in appearance,
and traveled with Jonathan and Zeppeli.
Though he could not learn Hamon, he did the best he could
and helped his friends.

[Part 2: Battle Tendency]
After Jonathan and Dio's battle ended, he moved to America
and made his fortune in oil. With it he founded the "Speedwagon Foundation,"
which supports the Joestar family for generations.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0003:
[Part 1: Phantom Blood]
The man who taught Jonathan Hamon.
He met Jonathan while traveling in search of the Stone Mask.
Seeing hope in Jonathan's hidden talent as a Hamon warrior,
he taught him that the hymn of humanity is a hymn of "courage," and passed on its importance.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0004:
[Part 1: Phantom Blood]
Jonathan's emotional support since childhood. When Jonathan was
wounded fighting Dio, she devotedly nursed him until he awoke.
The two later married, and she became Erina Joestar.

[Part 2: Battle Tendency]
She raised Joseph, moving from London to New York,
where Speedwagon lives. Still as graceful as ever,
she treats everyone with boundless kindness.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0006:
[Part 1: Phantom Blood]
A young man of low birth with a charisma
that draws people in. Cornered by Jonathan at the Joestar Mansion,
he put on the Stone Mask, gave up his humanity and became a vampire.
In Speedwagon's words, "evil born and bred."
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0007:
[Part 1: Phantom Blood]
Tonpetty's disciple, who trained in Hamon alongside Dire.
When saving Poco and his sister from vampires, he was surrounded
by four enemies, yet calmly defeated them all in an instant
without a flicker on his stern face.
"I, Straizo, will show no mercy!"

[Part 2: Battle Tendency]
In his youth he was a brave warrior who stood with Jonathan
against Dio Brando, but as he grew old he came to envy Dio's
agelessness, and turned himself into a vampire with a Stone Mask
found by the Speedwagon Foundation.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0010:
[Part 2: Battle Tendency]
He looks just like Jonathan, but is a joker with
an almost opposite personality. Born able to breathe Hamon naturally,
he became a far tougher warrior training under Lisa Lisa.
In battle he excels at outwitting, deceiving and toying with enemies.

[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
To save his daughter Holy from DIO's clutches, and to end the feud
that began in his grandfather's day, he sets out with his grandson Jotaro.
Still as crafty as ever, he fights with both Hamon and his Stand.
Stand: "Hermit Purple"

[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
At 79, his powers of observation and analysis are still sharp.
Things were awkward at first with Josuke, his son by
Tomoko Higashikata, but after they saved a stranger's baby
together, the tension seemed to ease a little.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0011:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
Joseph Joestar's Stand, "Hermit Purple."
It can produce spirit photography through media such as a Polaroid camera.
Not a combat Stand, but Joseph's insight and adaptability
make it highly versatile. It can also channel Hamon.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0012:
[Part 2: Battle Tendency]
A young Italian man whose grandfather was Will A. Zeppeli.
He trained in Hamon under Lisa Lisa together with Joseph.
The two clashed when they first met, but through shared hardship
he realized "his good side lies deep in his heart,"
and a friendship grew.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0013:
[Part 2: Battle Tendency]
Joseph and Caesar's Hamon teacher.
A formidable Hamon warrior herself, she fights with the scarf around her neck.
Hamon energy keeps her beautiful, but she's actually 50.
In Joseph's words, "An old hag?! *gulp*... Normally, that is..."
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0014:
[Part 2: Battle Tendency]
One of the "Pillar Men," found fused with a stone pillar in Mexico
by a Speedwagon Foundation excavation team.
Awakened by German army experiments, his advanced intelligence
let him corner humans in no time.
In Speedwagon's words, "the most evolved creature on Earth!"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0015:
[Part 2: Battle Tendency]
One of the "Pillar Men," who uses the Mode of Wind.
A true fighter who lives for battle and treasures its fulfillment above all,
declaring, "Strong warriors are the truth... the brave are my friends,
those I respect!!"
He hates anyone stepping into his shadow so much that he
reflexively attacks, even if it's Kars or Esidisi.
Kars and Caesar call him "a genius of combat."
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0016:
[Part 2: Battle Tendency]
One of the "Pillar Men," who uses the Mode of Heat.
Facing Joseph, he saw through his plan and gained the upper hand,
only to lose to Joseph, who had read even that.
Casting aside his pride to live on for his comrades at any cost,
he possessed Suzi Q, but Joseph's clever use of "positive" and
"negative" Hamon thwarted him.
When he's so enraged he might go mad, he bawls
to cool his head.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0017:
[Part 2: Battle Tendency]
The most intelligent of the "Pillar Men" and the inventor of
the Stone Mask. With Wamuu and Esidisi, he pursued the Red Stone of Aja
for 5,000 years, an obsession that astonished even Joseph.
His Mode is "Light."
His goal is to become the "Ultimate Being," and he is ruthless,
willing to use any means, yet he shows kindness to dogs,
flowers and other non-human things.
"No matter what methods I use... in the end...
 as long as I win, that's all that matters!!"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0018:
[Part 2: Battle Tendency]
An arrogant German officer who boasts that everything about his
country is superior to any other. Yet he also holds a proud conviction,
ready to sacrifice himself for his homeland.
He gave the badly wounded Speedwagon a truth serum to learn about
the "Pillar Men" and ended up awakening Santana, but believes
even that is a triumph of his country's technology.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0019:
[Part 2: Battle Tendency]
A cheerful, charming Italian woman who serves Lisa Lisa.
After Joseph and the others saved her from Esidisi's brain and
blood vessels, which had taken over her body, she saw the group off
as they chased the Red Stone of Aja.

[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
She married Joseph Joestar and gave birth to their daughter Holy.
As curious and active as ever, she often troubles their butler Roses.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0022:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
Joseph Joestar's grandson.
His Stand power awakened when DIO was revived.
People tend to see him as cold, rebellious and indifferent,
but his mother Holy knows "he's truly a kind boy."
Stand: "Star Platinum"

[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
He has become a marine adventurer, apparently fairly well known in academia.
He came to Morioh in Joseph's place to find Josuke
for the division of the Joestar inheritance.

[Part 5: Golden Wind]
A leading figure in marine biology.
A member of the Joestar family, with its feud with DIO,
and the very man who defeated DIO.
Calm, composed and taciturn, but with a strong sense of justice inside.
He asked Koichi to find a person named "Haruno Shiobana."
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0023:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
Jotaro Kujo's Stand, "Star Platinum."
On top of power and speed, it can move with precision beyond any machine.
Its range is short, but its power is second to none.
It shouts "ORA ORA" during its rush attacks.

[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
In Part 4, it appears as a fully perfected Stand.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0024:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
A Stand User who came to Japan with Joseph to get Jotaro
out of jail. A fortune teller, he also named Jotaro's Stand
"Star Platinum." He can be short-tempered, but only because
he cares about his friends; a truly passionate man.
Stand: "Magician's Red"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0025:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
Muhammad Avdol's Stand, "Magician's Red."
It controls scorching flames at will and can melt even iron instantly,
so enemies are very wary of it and often make it their first target.
Its signature move is "Crossfire Hurricane."
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0026:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
A young man implanted with a flesh bud by DIO who became
the first assassin sent after Jotaro's group. He knows himself well
and excels at mid- to long-range attacks. A Stand User since birth,
he spent his youth keeping others at a distance, but in Jotaro and
the others he found true friends who understood him.
Stand: "Hierophant Green"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0027:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
Noriaki Kakyoin's Stand, "Hierophant Green."
Not very powerful, but long-ranged; its specialty is "Emerald Splash,"
firing its destructive energy as gem-like bullets.
It can also slip into a human body to control it, or spread itself
throughout its range to form a barrier.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0028:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
A Frenchman who, like Kakyoin, had a flesh bud implanted by DIO.
He can be simple-minded, but never loses his proud chivalry.
He spent about 10 years honing his power to find "the man with
two right hands" who killed his sister, and his skill as a Stand User
made Jotaro think "he's not someone I can go easy on."
Stand: "Silver Chariot"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0029:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
Jean Pierre Polnareff's Stand, "Silver Chariot."
A close-range Stand that looks like a medieval knight and fights with a rapier.
Already fast, it can move so quickly it leaves afterimages
once it sheds its armor.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0030:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
A dog Stand User who joined Jotaro's group as a "helper."
He loves coffee-flavored chewing gum, but never truly opens up
to anyone. He loves ripping out people's hair by the clump, and has the
vulgar habit of farting in their faces while he does it.
On the other hand, he has his own conscience and sense of justice:
"I can't let a kid who loves dogs die."
Stand: "The Fool"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0031:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
Iggy's Stand, "The Fool."
It can control sand and merge itself with sand,
which makes it truly shine on defense.
It can also form glider wings out of sand to soar through the air,
though apparently not for long.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0032:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
One of DIO's assassins, a cunning old man.
A born villain who uses his Stand to kill travelers, making it look
like an accident, and steals their valuables.
He seems to have first been hired by DIO for money, but now swears loyalty to him.
His tongue has a stag beetle-shaped dent.
Stand: "Tower of Gray"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0033:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
"Tower of Gray," a Stand shaped like a stag beetle.
It pierces people's tongues with its "Tower Needle" and rips them out.
It's even faster than Star Platinum.
Its attacks are brutal; as Kakyoin puts it,
"A hideous Stand has a hideous user."
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0034:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
A Stand User who killed the captain of the ship Jotaro's group chartered
to Singapore, and took his place.
After falling for Jotaro's bluff and being exposed, he dragged Jotaro
into the sea, his specialty, for a one-on-one fight.
Stand: "Dark Blue Moon"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0035:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
Fake Captain Tennille's Stand, "Dark Blue Moon."
It has four eyes and looks like a fish-man.
As it looks, it excels at underwater combat, making water cutters sharper
than a ship's propeller with the claws and webbing on its limbs,
and shredding foes with sharp scales released into whirlpools it creates.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0038:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
One of the Stand Users Enya the Hag sent for DIO.
An assassin billed as a Native American shaman,
hired by mafia, soldiers and politicians.
He goads his targets into hurting him, so his whole body is covered in scars.
Stand: "Ebony Devil"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0039:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
Devo the Cursed's Stand, "Ebony Devil."
The more its user resents the target, the stronger it becomes.
It possesses a doll and attacks remotely.
The doll looks like a child and spews vulgar insults.
It attacks with tools like razors, saws and spears, and by biting.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0040:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
One of the assassins hired by DIO for money to attack Jotaro.
He used his Stand to disguise himself as Kakyoin, and with its overwhelming
defense seemed to have Jotaro cornered, until the Joestar family's
traditional battle tactic, "Run away," turned the tables,
and his prized handsome face got pummeled.
Stand: "Yellow Temperance"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0041:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
Rubber Soul's Stand, "Yellow Temperance."
A yellow, slime-like Stand that Rubber Soul calls "armor that absorbs power"
and "a defensive wall that attacks." When it touches a living thing,
it dissolves and devours the flesh, adding it to its own power.
Rubber Soul boasts that it "has no weakness!", but
defeat the Stand User and you defeat the Stand.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0042:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
A man who styles himself as a gunslinger out of a Western. Despite his
flippant manner, he is a highly skilled assassin. His life philosophy
is "Better No. 2 than No. 1!", and he shines with a partner.
He fought Jotaro's group twice and survived, a man of great luck.
Stand: "Emperor"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0043:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
Hol Horse's Stand, "Emperor."
A gun-shaped Stand whose bullets are also part of the Stand.
So it never runs out of ammo, and can even change the bullets' path.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0050:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
An old woman who worships DIO and swears loyalty to him.
She is astonishingly agile for her age, able to run as fast as
Polnareff fleeing at full speed.
She knows a great deal about Stands and how their powers manifest,
and taught DIO the method.
Stand: "Justice"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0051:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
Enya the Hag's Stand, "Justice."
A fog-like Stand that can enter the body through wounds to control people,
and can also create illusions.
Able to control many people at once, it was feared as
"the strongest Stand," in Hol Horse's words.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0052:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
Reduced to a head in his final battle with Jonathan, he later took
Jonathan's body and awoke from a 100-year sleep as DIO.
Still a vampire, he now also has a Stand.
With an overwhelming evil charisma and a gift for seizing people's hearts,
he gives off an eerie allure.
Stand: "The World"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0053:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
DIO's Stand, "The World."
The same type of Stand as Jotaro's "Star Platinum,"
with top-class speed and power, and moreover
the ability to "stop time."
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0064:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
The first Stand User to stand in the way of Jotaro's group in Egypt,
one of the Users representing the Egyptian Nine Glory Gods.
Having awakened to his Stand as a child,
he had no fear of crime or murder, or even of death, until he met DIO,
the first person in the world to recognize his worth. He came to feel,
"I'm not afraid to die, but I couldn't stand being abandoned
and killed by him."
"Even evil needs its own savior," he says, sworn in fierce
loyalty to DIO.
Stand: "Geb"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0065:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
N'Doul's Stand, "Geb" of the Egyptian Nine Glory Gods.
A remote-controlled water Stand. It usually takes the shape of an arm
with sharp claws, but can change freely as needed.
It moves fast, and can even enter a target's windpipe to suffocate them.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0068:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
One of DIO's assassins, the younger of the Oingo Boingo Brothers.
Very shy, he always sticks with his older brother Oingo.
After his brother was injured, he teamed up with Hol Horse
to stand in the way of Jotaro's group.
He's known for his peculiar laughs: "Uhyaho kokekoke" and
"Guhihi guhihi guhi."
Stand: "Tohth"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0069:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
A comic-book Stand, "Tohth" of the Egyptian Nine Glory Gods.
A comic that shows the near future; once printed, its prophecies
are never wrong. But even if you act exactly as the page says,
misinterpreting it can be dangerous.
The comic's title is "The Great Adventures of the Oingo Boingo Brothers."
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0070:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
A Stand with no user, "Anubis" of the Egyptian Nine Glory Gods.
Using a sword as its medium, it takes over whoever picks it up, such as Chaka,
and attacks Jotaro's group as DIO's assassin. Its wielder becomes
a master swordsman who grows stronger the more it fights: "I've learned that one..."
Once it learns an attack, it keeps that fighting skill even if its wielder
changes: a terrifying Stand.
Its attacks can pass through objects to cut things behind them.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0071:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
A female Stand User who worships DIO, representing one of
the Egyptian Nine Glory Gods. Joseph calls her legs "the bomb," and she
is very beautiful, but when enraged she pulls a horrible face
and hurls foul insults.
She told Joseph "I thought I wouldn't mind being your lover," but then
showed her loyalty to DIO: "You're nowhere near as charming
as Lord DIO."
Stand: "Bastet"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0072:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
Mariah's Stand.
A Stand that looks like an electrical outlet and can be stuck anywhere.
Anyone who touches the outlet is turned into a magnet.
The magnetism grows stronger over time, but weakens if
the user and the target get too far apart.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0077:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
A falcon Stand User representing one of the Egyptian Nine Glory Gods.
Not a guard dog but a "guard bird" that ruthlessly eliminates anyone
approaching DIO's mansion. Extremely cruel, once it judged Iggy an enemy
it chased him relentlessly, attacking so fiercely that Iggy thought
"I'll be killed unless I give up a front leg."
In the story it acts in very un-birdlike ways, like twisting the corner
of its beak or licking and spitting out the blood from its wounded chest.
Stand: "Horus"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0078:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
Pet Shop's Stand. It controls cold air and ice at will.
It looks like a pterosaur skeleton, and its main attack is
firing icicle missiles from its six arm-like limbs.
It can also freeze wounds to stop bleeding.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0081:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
A subordinate absolutely loyal to DIO,
so much so that he would gladly cut off his own head if asked.
He carries out his mission without showing emotion, but anyone who mocks DIO
sends him into a rage, transforming his mind into a void of darkness itself.
Stand: "Cream"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0082:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
Vanilla Ice's Stand.
Its mouth holds a void of darkness; anything swallowed
is smashed to dust and dies. No one knows where it goes.
By putting its user inside its mouth, it becomes an invisible sphere
merged with the void. Moving in this state erases everything in its path
in an instant. However, the user can't see outside,
so to check the situation it must be undone and reappear.
In DIO's words, a Stand that vanishes completely from this world's space.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0083:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
Joseph's daughter and Jotaro's mother.
When DIO awoke, her Stand power manifested, but lacking a fighting spirit
she couldn't control it, fell to a high fever and was given 50 days to live.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0085:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
A first-year at Budogaoka High School in Morioh, S City, M Prefecture.
Usually easygoing, but he snaps if anyone insults his hair.
The change is so drastic that Jotaro called him "seriously dangerous."
The son of Joseph Joestar, which makes him Jotaro's "uncle."
He gained his Stand power when he was 4.
Stand: "Crazy Diamond"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0086:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
Josuke Higashikata's Stand.
Its power and speed rival Jotaro's "Star Platinum,"
attacking mainly with rapid punches and powerful blows.
It also has the special ability to restore things to their original state,
such as healing wounds or repairing broken walls.
But when Josuke "snaps," it may reshape things instead.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0087:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
A first-year at Budogaoka High School, Josuke's classmate.
A timid, ordinary boy, he met Jotaro and Josuke on his first day of school
and got drawn into the many bizarre incidents in Morioh.
Fighting alongside them, he grows in spirit.
Keicho Nijimura's "Bow and Arrow" awakened his Stand power.
Stand: "Echoes"

[Part 5: Golden Wind]
A high school boy living in Morioh, S City, M Prefecture, Japan.
Kind and good-natured, but he bravely stands up to anything
that threatens him or his friends.
He came to Neapolis, Italy, looking for a person named
"Haruno Shiobana."
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0088:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
Koichi Hirose's Stand. ACT1, ACT2 and ACT3
each have different abilities.

■ACT1
It launches manga-style sound effect lettering that sticks and makes sounds.
It was an egg when first manifested, but as Koichi grew in spirit,
it awakened with the form and powers of ACT1.

■ACT2
The form ACT1 grew into by shedding its skin, in response to Koichi's growth
while living a terrifyingly abnormal life of becoming a "fine man."
It attacks with sound effect words made with its tail,
making the effects of those words real.

■ACT3
The form it grew into by shedding ACT2, as if responding to Koichi's peril.
It looks like a child and can talk.
It acts on its user's "orders" and is far faster
than ACT1 or ACT2.
Its finisher, "Echoes 3 FREEZE," makes its target heavy,
and the closer the target is to the user, the heavier it gets.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0089:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
A first-year at Budogaoka High School, Keicho's younger brother.
His speech and actions aren't very bright, but he's warm-hearted and kind,
and fights with Josuke and Koichi to protect Morioh.
He has an outstanding talent for describing food.
He's in the same class as Yukako.
Stand: "The Hand"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0090:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
Okuyasu Nijimura's Stand.
Its "right hand" can scrape away space.
No one knows where the scraped-away parts go.
Besides attacking directly, by scraping away space it can pull a target
toward it with "teleportation," or move its user.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0091:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
A popular manga artist living in S City, M Prefecture, author of "Pink Dark Boy."
Always chasing the best material, he doesn't draw from imagination or fantasy:
he believes "reality" is the essence of entertainment, and gets involved
in many incidents in Morioh as research.
He doesn't get along with Josuke or Okuyasu, but often acts with Koichi,
who is "on his wavelength," and is especially close to him.
One of his favorite things is telling someone who thinks they're tough "NO."
Stand: "Heaven's Door"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0092:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
Rohan Kishibe's Stand. It turns its target into a "book."
He can read the target's "memories" from its pages, and erase them
by tearing out pages.
He can also control the target's actions by writing on the pages.
He cannot read his own "distant memories" or "fate."
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0097:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
A first-year at Budogaoka High School, in the same class as Okuyasu.
Her Stand power manifested when Keicho Nijimura's "Bow and Arrow" pierced her chest.
She harbors an abnormal love for Koichi. She is extremely obsessive,
and shows no mercy to anything that gets in her way.
Even toward Koichi, whom she adores, her "love" drives her to terrifyingly abnormal acts.
Stand: "Love Deluxe"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0098:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
Yukako Yamagishi's Stand. It lets her control her own hair.
She can extend it to bind targets, pull them, or plant it in them
to restrict their movement: a highly versatile ability.
When her emotions run high, her hair can grow enough to cover a whole house.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0099:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
The owner of the Italian restaurant "Trussardi" in Morioh.
There is no menu; he looks at each customer and decides
what to serve. With his skill of "seeing the whole body from the hands,"
he pinpointed Okuyasu's ailments exactly.
Food made with his Stand can cure those ailments.
He hates people entering his kitchen uninvited and is very strict about hygiene.
When Josuke walked into the kitchen without permission or washing his hands
with soap, he was furious and made him clean the whole kitchen.
"I serve food to make you feel wonderful."
Stand: "Pearl Jam"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0100:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
Tonio Trussardi's Stand.
Mixed into his food, it cures the ailments of those who eat it, but
when it takes effect, unreal things happen: sleep deprivation makes
tears gush from the eyes like a waterfall, and cavities pop out
with new teeth growing in at terrifying speed.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0103:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
A second-year at Budogaoka Middle School, weighing 110 kg,
nicknamed "Shigechi."
His speech and looks are lovably endearing, but he's clever enough
to think up ways to collect money with his Stand.
He's very attached to money, and sometimes his miserly side shows.
Stand: "Harvest"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0104:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
Shigechi's Stand. A swarm of tiny "remote-controlled" Stands.
By his own account, he can summon about 500 of them.
Each is weak, but they act on his orders, swarming to scrape away skin,
injecting liquids like alcohol into blood vessels, or even carrying
their user "bucket brigade" style, making the most of their numbers.
Shigechi mainly uses this power for "collecting."
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0105:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
A beautician who runs the beauty salon "Cinderella" in Morioh, and calls
herself a creator of "faces of happiness." Since childhood she has admired
the fairy godmother in "Cinderella" and wants to bring people
happiness like her.
Her sign reads "Makeup to Help You Find Love," but in truth
her treatments use her Stand.
Stand: "Cinderella"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0106:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
Aya Tsuji's Stand.
A robot-like Stand that can change a person's fortune by reshaping
features such as their face or palm lines.
The effect usually lasts about 30 minutes; to keep it longer, Cinderella's
lipstick must be reapplied every 30 minutes. If this promise is broken,
the makeup crumbles into a horrible mess.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0107:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
A biker gang boy, proud and narcissistic.
While recovering from a motorcycle accident, he was shot with the "Arrow"
by the "Photo Dad," awakening his Stand. Since then his sense of smell
has been abnormally keen. He avoids trouble, but when it counts he's warm-hearted.
He truly cares for his three girls, "Reiko," "Akemi" and "Yoshie."
Stand: "Highway Star"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0108:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
Yuya Fungami's Stand. It can move at 60 km/h.
It chases anyone who enters its trap "room" anywhere and drains their "nutrients."
Once it touches you, Highway Star has no weakness.
It can split from its humanoid form into footprint-like shapes.
If targeted, the only way to survive is to find and defeat
the "user." Drained "nutrients" nourish the user.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0111:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
Dubbed "Angelo" by the newspapers, the most sickening criminal
in Japanese history, with an IQ of 160.
He lives to ruin "people who get full of themselves."
About half a month before his execution, Keicho's "Bow and Arrow"
awakened his "Stand"; he then broke out of prison and hid in Morioh.
Stand: "Aqua Necklace"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0112:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
Angelo's Stand. Weak, but remote-controlled.
It disguises itself as liquids like milk or whiskey, or as steam,
and gets inside a target's body to possess and control them,
or to destroy them from within.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0113:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
Okuyasu's big brother. Searching for a certain "Stand power," he uses
the "Bow and Arrow" to create Stand Users all over Morioh.
Meticulous by nature, he favors orderly formations and tactics in battle.
"When you finish listening to a CD,
you put it neatly back in its case before playing the next one, right?
Everyone does that. I do that too."
Stand: "Bad Company"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0114:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
A miniature army Stand made of soldiers and weapons: 7 tanks,
4 "Apache" attack helicopters and 60 infantrymen.
Each unit does little damage, but their volleys and sustained fire
are truly destructive. Reflecting the meticulous nature of its user,
Keicho Nijimura, it carries out orderly formations and tactics under his command.
Also, as a swarm-type Stand, "Bad Company" doesn't pass damage
to its user when just 2 or 3 units are defeated.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0115:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
19 years old. His dream is to become an ultra-super guitarist.
Keicho Nijimura shot him with the Stand "Arrow," awakening his Stand.
He's careful enough to use it to achieve his goals without ever
showing himself, but gets carried away easily
when things go his way.
In his own words, "I'm... strong once I reflect on my mistakes..."
Stand: "Red Hot Chili Pepper"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0116:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
Akira Otoishi's Stand. An electric Stand.
It is remote-controlled and can travel at high speed wherever electricity flows.
It can even hide inside power sources such as batteries.
It can turn its targets into electricity and drag them into power lines or outlets.
By absorbing electricity it strengthens its "Stand power," and with enough
it can rival Jotaro's Star Platinum. But without electricity it grows weak
and looks like scrap metal.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0117:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
Two "Stand rats," ordinary sewer rats that gained "Stand powers"
from the "Bow and Arrow."
The one with a notched ear is called "Bug-Eaten," the other "Not Bug-Eaten."
On top of their animal instincts and habits, their Stand powers gave them
the intelligence to outwit humans.
As Jotaro says, "This thing... isn't a creature
that should be allowed to live on this Earth anymore..."
Stand: "Ratt"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0118:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
The power manifested by the Stand rats: it looks like a fixed gun turret and fires needles.
Touching a needle spreads something like a "Stand poison"
that melts the body, and even Stands.
With point-blank shots, long-range sniping and ricochets,
it indiscriminately "hunts" anything in its territory.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0119:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
A 33-year-old single man living in Morioh.
Outwardly an unremarkable ordinary office worker, but in truth a vicious
serial killer with an abnormal "nature" that compels him to kill.
Obsessed with women's "hands," he has been secretly committing murders.
He only wants to live a quiet, peaceful life, and ruthlessly eliminates
anything that gets in its way.
Stand: "Killer Queen"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0120:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
Yoshikage Kira's Stand. It turns whatever it touches into a "bomb."

■First Bomb
By touching an object, it can turn anything into a bomb.
The bomb can be detonated when it touches the target,
or by pressing the switch on its hand.
Its power can be adjusted, and the blast can even be used to move its user.

■Second Bomb: Sheer Heart Attack
A bomb tank launched only from Killer Queen's left arm.
It automatically homes in on "heat" such as body heat and explodes on contact.
It prioritizes whatever gives off the most "heat."
Its armor is so hard that even Jotaro's Star Platinum
called it "a sturdy Stand."

■Third Bomb: Bites the Dust
A power born from Kira's wish to live quietly.
Killer Queen possesses the affected person, and it detonates when anyone
threatens to expose its "user's" "identity," automatically eliminating the snoop.
At the same time it blows away the "facts" uncovered and rewinds time
to a peaceful state.
Even after a rewind, "fates" such as deaths that have already happened
cannot be changed, so victims die at the time of detonation regardless of conditions.
To avoid this, Bites the Dust must be undone.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0123:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
Originally an ordinary British Blue cat, it gained a Stand power
after someone attacked it with the "Arrow."
After an accident it fell into a state of suspended animation
and became a cat-plant (Stray Cat).
Living on "desire and instinct," it intuitively grasped the "nature and use"
of its "power," and used it for its own benefit.
It can not only form and fire balls of air, but can even pump air
into an enemy's blood vessels to cause an air embolism
(blood vessels blocked by air), a terrifying ability.
It's so cunning that even Kosaku Kawajiri said, "That was close..."
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0129:
[Part 1: Phantom Blood]
[Part 2: Battle Tendency]
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
Energy produced by "breathing," a method of controlling the body
that Will A. Zeppeli studied for many years. Like ripples on water,
special breathing creates ripples "in the body," generating energy.
In the East, this is called "Sendo."
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0130:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
"Life energy" given concrete form, appearing with a distinct shape
and power.
Stands share common rules: every Stand has a user, each person has one Stand,
and if a Stand is hurt its user takes the same damage, but exceptions exist.
Each Stand's vision and power differ.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0131:
[Part 1: Phantom Blood]
[Part 2: Battle Tendency]
A stone mask whose origins date back to the "blood rituals" of the Aztecs,
drawing strange fates to its owners across the ages.
When worn and given blood, its bone spikes pierce the brain,
unlocking unknown powers and creating an undying body: a "vampire."
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0132:
[Part 1: Phantom Blood]
A creature that appeared before Will A. Zeppeli just as he began explaining
Hamon energy to Jonathan, as if drawn by "fate."
Unfazed even when its life was in danger, it helped Jonathan
deepen his understanding of Hamon. After Zeppeli channeled Hamon into it,
the rock beneath it was smashed, but it returned safely to the river.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0133:
[Part 2: Battle Tendency]
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
A foundation Speedwagon established with the fortune he made in oil.
It mainly researches medicine and archaeology; its true aim is to uncover
the truth about the "Stone Mask." It backs up the Joestar family,
providing information on new Stand Users and treating injured allies.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0134:
[Part 2: Battle Tendency]
Also known as the "Super Aja."
Aja is a beautiful gem rarely found in nature. Light reflects hundreds of
millions of times inside the crystal, amplifying and radiating from a single
point: a miraculous power created by nature. Among them, a flawless
"Red Stone" without a single cloud is the Super Aja.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0135:
[Part 1: Phantom Blood]
The path leading to the mansion owned by George Joestar I.
This is where Jonathan and Will A. Zeppeli met.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0138:
[Part 2: Battle Tendency]
The vast desert that stretches across Mexico.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0139:
[Part 2: Battle Tendency]
Where the German army investigated the truth about the "Pillar Men."
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0140:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
A bedroom town of S City that grew rapidly from the early 1980s.
The town flower is the Amur adonis; its specialty is miso-pickled beef tongue.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0141:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
A Morioh landmark. Despite its creepy look, "Angelo Rock" is loved by
the townsfolk as a signpost and a meeting place for lovers.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0142:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
Okuyasu's house, just a stone's throw from Josuke's.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0143:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
A Morioh landmark. "Cape Boyoyon" became famous from a rumor among fishermen
that "the cape's rock gently bounced away, boing, a young woman
about to kill herself."
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0144:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
A Morioh landmark. "Rohan Kishibe's House" sits on 103 tsubo of land,
with 7 bedrooms plus an attic. If you actually visit, he'll pretend he's not home.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0146:
[Part 1: Phantom Blood]
A warrior who trained in Hamon with Zeppeli under their master Tonpetty,
his close friend of 20 years who endured the harsh training with him.
Seeking revenge for his friend's death, he tried to hit Dio with his
Thunder Cross Split Attack, but Dio's Vaporization Freezing Technique
froze him from the neck down and shattered him.
Yet with his last strength he flung a single Hamon-charged rose
into Dio's right eye.
Inspired by that attack, Jonathan took on Dio.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0147:
[Part 1: Phantom Blood]
A legendary knight whose grave Dio desecrated, reviving him as a zombie.
In life he was a loyal retainer of Mary Stuart, a hero who could cut
through rock like butter with his sword.
He surrendered to the enemy with Bruford on the promise that the captive
Mary's life would be spared, but learned just before execution it was a trap,
and died in bitter regret, cursing the world and hating mankind.
Revived as a zombie, he became cruel and vile, ready to kill even children:
"All I'll do is kill with my strength and destroy everything!"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0148:
[Part 1: Phantom Blood]
A dead man revived as a zombie along with Tarkus.
When the enemy broke its promise and executed him, he died in bitter regret
like Tarkus, spitting a curse: "I'll curse your descendants
to the very last generation!!"
Even as a zombie, he never lost his pride as a knight, and dueled Jonathan
as a warrior. When Jonathan's Hamon restored his human heart,
he entrusted Jonathan with the "Sword of Luck and Courage" and passed on to join Mary.
His specialty is "Danse Macabre Hair," wielding his hair
as a weapon.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0149:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
A timid young man living in Egypt.
Anubis took over his mind, awakening him as a master swordsman Stand User
and one of DIO's assassins. His attitude and personality changed too,
becoming bold and manly.
"I'll be taking your life..."
His blunt way of speaking even impressed Polnareff.
Stand: "Anubis"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0150:
[Part 1: Phantom Blood]
An Asian man who once sold poisons on Ogre Street.
He met Dio back then; the poison Dio was feeding Jonathan's father
was bought from Wang Chan.
He came looking for the Stone Mask amid the fire at the Joestar Mansion,
but the wounded Dio drank his blood and he became a zombie.
Since then, he has been fiercely loyal to Dio.
"You! I'll scoop your brains out with my fingers!
 You slowpoke!"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0151:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
Known as the Enigma Boy.
His Stand power was awakened by the "Photo Dad."
He enjoys "observing" others, cornering them mentally
and drawing out their fear.
Stand: "Enigma"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0152:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
Terunosuke Miyamoto's Stand.
It can turn targets into "paper," and unfolding the paper restores them.
It activates when the target shows their "sign of fear."
The Stand itself has no power or attack ability, but turning things into
"paper" seals them away completely.
It can turn not only objects like taxis and Kyushu tonkotsu ramen,
but even electricity and fire into "paper" to carry around.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0153:
[Part 2: Battle Tendency]
Cornered after Joseph channeled the final Hamon into his arm,
the cunning and relentless Kars had put on the Stone Mask fitted with the Super Aja
just as Stroheim's German troops blasted him with ultraviolet light to finish him.
Pushed by the Super Aja's power, the bone spikes transformed Kars
into the "Ultimate Being (Ultimate Thing)."
Though a Pillar Man, his body no longer perishes in sunlight;
he is invincible, never ages and never dies.
He possesses the abilities of every living thing, and surpasses them.
And his form is founded on beauty, like a Greek sculpture.
In Speedwagon's words, "He has no weakness at all!"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0154:
[Part 2: Battle Tendency]
With the Red Stone stolen, Joseph and the others arrived in St. Moritz,
Switzerland. There they met Stroheim, who should have been blown to bits
in Mexico.
He had a steel prosthetic arm, a strange mechanical brace on his face,
and a body rebuilt as a machine that can fire 600 armor-piercing rounds
a minute. All of it was built based on Santana's power, with calculations
of how finely Kars and the others must be shredded
to stop their life functions.
"My body is the crystallization and pride
 of the highest intellect of the German people!!"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0155:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
DIO, cornered by Jotaro in Egypt.
Seizing an opening in the pursuit, he managed to absorb Joseph's blood,
shouting "I feel absolutely HIGH!", thrilled that thanks to
Joseph Joestar's blood, his body, Jonathan Joestar's,
fit him perfectly at last.
He can now stop time for more seconds, and has grown stronger.
"I gained immortality 100 years ago... but never
have I felt this splendid and refreshed!"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0156:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
Yoshikage Kira, his face and fingerprints changed by Aya Tsuji's Stand.
As Kosaku Kawajiri, he lives in the Kawajiri home with Kosaku's wife Shinobu
and son Hayato. The real Kosaku, Kira's victim, was a perfectly ordinary man
whom Shinobu called "a boring man."
He acted to blend into Kosaku's life, but after an incident triggered
his "invincible" power, "Bites the Dust," his looks changed
and he began acting boldly.
Within "Killer Queen: Bites the Dust," a "fate" that has happened once
will always happen, and what has been destroyed once
will always be destroyed.
"Fate is what carries your life to you!
 ...Heh, well said indeed."
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0157:
[Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable]
Yoshikage Kira's Stand, Killer Queen, with Stray Cat in its belly.
Thinking Stray Cat's power to control "air" could be used for
Killer Queen's explosions, Kira kept it in his attic,
even though he had once judged it an enemy.
Hit by Josuke and Okuyasu's attacks, he shrewdly made use of the Stray Cat
Hayato had brought, and won it over to his side.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0158:
[Part 2: Battle Tendency]
A servant at Lisa Lisa's mansion and Joseph and Caesar's assistant instructor.
With Loggins, he welcomed the two after they cleared the "Hell Climb Pillar"
trial, and trained them hard for 3 weeks.
In the final Hamon trial he fought Caesar, whose Bubble Launcher's
"Hamon" sparks burned off all the fine hair on his right arm.
In that sorry state, he declared, "You pass, no question."
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0159:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
Before the final battle with DIO, Joseph warned Jotaro "never to lose
your cool in anger," but DIO's actions, mocking the Joestar bloodline,
enraged him.
That seemed to put him in a bit of danger, but
"This ain't nothin'... I'm not angry enough yet!"
Never giving up on defeating DIO, he staked everything on the 2 seconds
he was given, and awakened the power to stop time himself.
"The reason you lost... is just one thing, DIO...
 one simple answer...
 'You pissed me off.'"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0160:
[Part 3: Stardust Crusaders]
Polnareff possessed by Anubis, now able to fight dual-wielding
with two master swordsman Stands.
With the precision of Silver Chariot and the agility of Star Platinum,
his power was so terrifying that Jotaro himself thought,
"I really have to beat him... or he'll kill me..."
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0161:
[Part 5: Golden Wind]
A 15-year-old living in Neapolis.
Born to DIO, archenemy of the Joestar family, and a Japanese woman.
He has an iron will that holds to his convictions, and the composure
to handle the unexpected.
He dreams of becoming a Gang-Star.
Stand: "Gold Experience"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0162:
[Part 5: Golden Wind]
A member of the gang "Passione."
His eyes are always teary, an aftereffect of a knife stabbed
into his face in a fight.
He shook down taxi drivers picking up passengers at Neapolis Airport,
earning many grudges.
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0163:
[Part 5: Golden Wind]
A member of the gang "Passione." Age 20.
The team's leader, with a sharp mind and strong willpower.
With a strong sense of responsibility and the kindness to help people in trouble,
he is trusted by the organization's executives, his subordinates and the townsfolk.
Stand: "Sticky Fingers"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0164:
[Part 5: Golden Wind]
A member of the gang "Passione" and Bucciarati's subordinate.
Age 20. A former police officer. Wary and slow to trust others,
but willing to risk his life on the orders of someone he trusts.
Stand: "Moody Blues"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0165:
[Part 5: Golden Wind]
A member of the gang "Passione" and Bucciarati's subordinate.
Age 18. The team's simple, optimistic mood-maker.
His unbreakable spirit in any crisis supports the team.
He hates the number "4."
Stand: "Sex Pistols"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0166:
[Part 5: Golden Wind]
A member of the gang "Passione" and Bucciarati's subordinate.
Age 17. Grateful to Bucciarati, who once saved him,
he joined the organization to help him. Innocent, and bad at studying.
Stand: "Aerosmith"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0167:
[Part 5: Golden Wind]
A member of the gang "Passione" and Bucciarati's subordinate.
Age 16. Highly intelligent with an IQ of 152, and gentle and
gentlemanly in manner. But in truth he's short-tempered, and when he snaps
his ferocity scares even his teammates.
Stand: "Purple Haze"
text:Bokencho_YogoText_JP:YOGO_TEXT_0168:
[Part 5: Golden Wind]
An executive of the gang "Passione." He gives Giorno his entrance test.
So huge that when he lies down he could be mistaken for a bed,
he is imprisoned, yet lives in total comfort behind bars.
Stand: "Black Sabbath"

text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_006:
"Hamon Users" are strong against "Vampires" and "Pillar Men"!!
Bring them to Quests with lots of Vampires and Pillar Men!
Settle the feud where it all began, once and for all!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_007:
Set a Statue as Leader and its
Leader Ability activates!!
Check active Abilities on the Team screen!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_008:
Enhance Statues by fusion to grow their stats!
A "Great Success!!" gives tons of EXP!!
Use everything you've got to seize victory!!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_010:
Your Main Team's Leader is used as
a Support by other players!
No matter how tough the enemy, you've got
a strong ally, your Support, to the very end
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_011:
Admire your Statues up close in the Gallery!
Equip Minds, rotate your Statue, and in the end...
as long as you snap it in "Photo Mode," that's all that matters!!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_012:
Use Minds as materials to Enhance Statues!
Some special Minds give lots of EXP!
Grow strong... both you and me...
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_013:
Harmonize your spirits!
That is Boost!!
It happens when you obtain the same Statue!!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_014:
To gather Enhance materials efficiently,
Daily Quests are perfect!!
Note that the drops change by day of the week!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_015:
Equipping Minds raises
a Statue's stats!
Choose by looks, or by performance...
It's a tough call!!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_016:
Some Minds add new Skills and
SP Skills you can use in battle when equipped!
Check the "Mind List" for Minds
linked to Statues you own!!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_017: Make a quick fortune with sell-only Minds!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_018:
Unlocking the Growth Tree strengthens Statues!
The stats raised depend on which spaces you unlock!!
Not just Level Ups and Boosts, but the Growth Tree too...
Leave no stone unturned in strengthening your Statues!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_019:
Growth Trees for ★5 Statues and above
have spaces that add usable Skills!!
They're that Statue's finishing moves!!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_020:
Get the materials needed to unlock the Growth Tree
by clearing Daily Quests!
The higher the difficulty, the better
the materials you get!!!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_021:
Complete all the conditions to
earn a "Special Reward"!!
Don't forget to check the reward conditions before you sortie!!
If you're forgetful... better write 'em down!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_022:
Once you get Objects, place them in your Town!
Build a Town all your own!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_023:
Some combinations of Objects
give stat bonuses!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_024:
You can chat in your Town!
Have a great JOJO discussion!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_025:
[Jonathan Joestar]
"Feel the beat of my blood!!"
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_027:
[Joseph Joestar]
"I really love a good trick!"
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_028:
[Caesar Anthonio Zeppeli]
"Take this and go back to the sticks!!"
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_030:
[Rudol von Stroheim]
"I've got more guts than you, you coward!"
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_033:
[Noriaki Kakyoin]
"I know myself... I'm no fool."
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_036:
[Hol Horse]
"'The gun is mightier than the sword.' Mm-hmm~ Words to live by."
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_038:
[Josuke Higashikata]
"I'll protect this town and my mom."
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_039:
[Koichi Hirose]
"I won't take that sound away... until you cry and apologize!"
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_040:
[Okuyasu Nijimura]
"Where the heck does the stuff
 I scrape away go, anyway?"
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_041:
[Rohan Kishibe]
"I'll take your 'memories'!
 To use as material for my manga!"
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_042:
[Yukako Yamagishi]
"How dare yooou! You little bed-wetter!!"
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_043:
[Shigekiyo Yangu]
"There's no way you guys
 can beat my 'Harvest'..."
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_044:
[Anjuro Katagiri]
"It's fun watching people who get
 full of themselves get ruined. Heh heh."
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_045:
[Keicho Nijimura]
"It feels great when things go as announced!"
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_050:
When the Reversal Gauge fills, trigger
the deadly "Reversal Mode"!
Time to turn a pinch into a chance!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_051:
Chain your allies' attacks into combos to raise ATK!
Keeping the enemy from attacking is key too!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_052:
Raise Skill Levels with the "Growth Tree"
or "Mind Enhance" to power up your moves!
Now's the time to surpass yourself!!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_053:
Some Minds add moves you can use when equipped,
and some raise a Statue's stats!
Customize to your liking!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_054:
Equip the same Minds to trigger a "Mind Link"!
On top of the Minds' own performance,
you get a stat boost bonus!!
Check the boosted stats under Abilities!!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_055:
Data downloads happen only the first time!
The more you progress, the smoother it gets!
If you want to go all in at once...
download the data from "Options"!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_056:
Spin the free Mind Summon with "Friend Points"!
You get lots of Friend Points by bringing players
you mutually Follow on Quests!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_057:
The turn order is shown at the bottom left!
Your Statue can act when it reaches the far right!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_058:
Statues have the attributes [Courage], [Wisdom], [Spirit],
[Unity] and [Solitude],
each with advantages and disadvantages against others!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_060:
Some Skill icons
have arrows on them!
A right arrow makes your next action come sooner!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_061:
Hold down a Skill button to check
your next action after using it!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_062:
A Statue's action speed.
[Action Speed] is how quickly
a Statue's turn comes around!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_063:
The higher this number, the more likely
you are to reduce damage!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_064: The higher this number, the easier it is to hit enemies!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_065: The higher this number, the more likely you are to land critical hits!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_066:
Triggering Reversal Mode halves the
Cool Turns of Skills and SP Skills!
Unleash special attacks on the enemy in a row!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_067:
When your allies take consecutive turns and keep attacking,
a [Chain] builds and ATK rises!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_068:
Defeat all enemies in the final area while in Reversal
to enter [Reversal Overkill]!!
Keep hammering the enemy even at 0 HP for maximum damage!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_069:
Put 3 units in [Statue Team] to
[Swap] with the Reserve button!
Swap Statues based on enemy matchups!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_070:
Skills have [Cool Turns]!
Once that many turns pass,
the Skill can be used again!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_072:
"Solitude" is strong against "Unity"!!
Bring it to Quests with lots of Unity types!
A heart that needs no one is the first step to supremacy!!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_073:
"Unity" is strong against "Solitude"!!
Bring it to Quests with lots of Solitude types!
A valiant figure who braves danger inspires their allies!!
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_074:
Some Skills have [Speed]!
Skills with a [Big Right Arrow] make your next turn come sooner!
Skills with a [Small Right Arrow] might make it sooner!?
text:TipsText_JP:TipsText_100:
Control the characters recreated in 3D
and beat down the oncoming enemies!!
Build a team "all your own" that crosses the Parts,
and experience heated battles firsthand!!
